items.question: Is development part of UI/UX design?
items.answer: Design and development are different scopes. A design project can end at handoff, or the team can discuss development as a separate part of the work.

items.question: Can you work with our existing brand?
items.answer: Yes. Share your current brand guidance, assets and components so the design can build on what is already established.

items.question: How do revisions work?
items.answer: Review stages and revision rounds are agreed in the project scope. Consolidating feedback around user goals helps keep revisions focused.

items.question: How do you estimate timing and fees?
items.answer: The team will review your brief, available materials and deliverables before sharing a project-specific estimate. Changes in scope can affect both timing and cost.
